run_video_segmentation_davis: run video object segmentation on DAVIS 2017 dataset using a pretrained DINO ViT model
eval_video_tracking_davis: evaluate tracking on a video given the first frame segmentation and DINO model features
label_propagation: propagate segmentations from source frames to a target frame using feature affinity and top-k neighbors
extract_feature: extract patch-level visual features from a single frame using a pretrained DINO vision transformer
read_frame: read a single video frame from disk and preprocess it with resizing and color normalization
